title: Queue via two stacks
statementMd:
Simulate a FIFO queue with `['enqueue', x]` and `['dequeue']`. Return the list of values returned by dequeues (dequeues only happen on non-empty queues).

**Example:** `queue_ops([["enqueue", 1], ["enqueue", 2], ["dequeue"], ["enqueue", 3…)` returns `[1, 2, 3]`.
